office_does: Mason County's one District Court judge, elected county-wide for four years, hears and decides the court's cases, including criminal and protection-order matters.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge George Alan Steele, on the District Court bench since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Mason County District Court Judge since 2019 and a Shelton Municipal Court judge from 2009; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court Judge since January 2019, re-elected 2022; Shelton Municipal Court from 2009 [S1]
Says 'a judge is not a policy maker' and has authored two adopted court rules [S1]
In 2025 a Superior Court judge removed him from a protection-order case after he declined to find probable cause three times [S4][S5]
